Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: architectural design concept for the Prism Route coastal post-apocalyptic exploration game.
Input image 1 (Rhino screenshot) is the site-layout and camera reference: preserve its broad foreground crescent headland, the inlet on the right, the white low crescent-shaped Cliff B island building in the middle distance and the surrounding islets. Ignore all application UI, CAD lines and labels. The MAIN redesign is the large FOREGROUND headland cliff and its edge, NOT the central isolated Cliff B building.
Input image 2 is a formal-language reference for continuous sweeping shells, merging curving supports, planted terrain integrated with infrastructure. Do not copy its chalky stone texture.
Material: fabricated warm ivory white satin-gloss coated composite / engineered concrete, refined broad highlights, very subtle surface grain, warm gray shadows. Grass, meadow vegetation and small wind-shaped trees grow on top surfaces, in irregular clusters; restrained post-apocalyptic reclaiming, a few fine weather streaks only. Bright clear daylight, pale blue sky, turquoise water. Keep the architecture pristine enough to read its surface geometry, no heavy ruin aesthetic.
CRITICAL geometry: spatially continuous flowing doubly curved surfaces with major height variation ALONG their length. Crest and trough elevations vary visibly, edges rise and fall, shoulders twist, surfaces merge into curved ground ramps and structural haunches. Beautiful Zaha Hadid architectural language. The result must NOT be flat horizontal contour terraces, stacked flat slabs, uniform retaining-wall shelves, rice terraces, repeated level balconies, simplistic stepped podiums, a layer cake, concentric flat ledges, or merely rounded edges on flat terraces. Use 3 large coherent surface gestures, not dozens of layers. Clear usable walking areas connected by gentle curved ramps; planting sits on broad slopes and crowns rather than wrapping every edge as a flat strip. Road can change: one readable dark-gray road route integrated with the curved architecture, modest scale, plausible gentle vehicle grades. No fantasy impossible ramps, no highway spaghetti. Human and van scale cues tiny and unobtrusive. No lettering, labels, watermark, interface, arrows or diagrams. Cinematic high-end architectural rendering, clear concept geometry, not a CAD screenshot.

DESIGN A — continuous wave landform. Transform the foreground cliff into a connected topographic shell: three broad elongated white-and-green waves sweeping diagonally from the high left headland down toward the right-hand inlet. Each wave continuously rises, dips and banks; the middle wave swells upward into a grassy hill then drops into a shaded saddle. The lower wave curls out toward the sea and blends back into the upper landform via a soft rising ramp. Edge beams are thick sculptural white ribbons with convex and concave profiles, never level all the way. Some wave surfaces fade directly into the existing grassland instead of ending as a terrace. Where the middle shell lifts, create ONE long arched tunnel portal under its grassy crest; one road curves from upper left across a short elegant raised span and then enters that portal. Keep most of the landmass solid, with only that selective opening; this option feels like a continuous sculpted landscape, integrated and restrained.
Camera: same elevated oblique overview as input image 1, foreground redesigned waves occupy about two-thirds of frame, central original crescent island remains recognizable in the background, water and sandy small islets on right. Wide landscape 16:9. Strong directional daylight catches the varying heights and twisting white edges.

DESIGN B — interwoven rising shells. In the SAME site layout and SAME overview camera as design A, create three large asymmetrically interleaving leaf-shaped curving landform shells. Their long outer edges rise and descend gracefully rather than remaining level. One planted curved shell sweeps upward from the lower shoreline, twists over a shallow green valley, and reconnects to the main plateau. A second white shell crosses behind it at a different height, with one leg of each shell gradually thickening into a sculptural curved support rooted in the land. Their roots remain connected to the existing headland. Create selective large irregular arch-like daylight openings and a planted hollow between the shells, with visually smooth curvature transitions. No detached floating islands, no columns like conventional bridge piers, no regular arches repeated in a grid. This option is somewhat more open and spatially layered than A, but shares the same warm white flowing family and restrained scale. A single dark-gray road passes through one broad opening, transitions to a short smooth viaduct on curving haunch supports across the hollow, then rejoins the headland; a narrow pedestrian ramp follows a different sweeping shell edge. Keep a broad quiet crown area for meadow and small trees. No dense ornamental fins.
Camera: same elevated oblique overview as input image 1, foreground redesigned shells occupy about two-thirds of frame, central original crescent island remains recognizable in the background, water and sandy small islets on right. Wide landscape 16:9. Strong directional daylight describes torsion and the varying crest heights.
a_detail:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: near-view architectural concept, design A continuous wave landform, same Prism Route coastal region.
Input image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE design A overview: use its exact family of three elongated continuous planted wave shells and coastal setting. Input image 2 is supporting architectural curve language only.
Generate a NEW CAMERA view within design A, NOT a different scheme. Put the camera on the lowest seafront pedestrian route, about human standing eye height, looking diagonally uphill along the coastline. Frame the raised middle wave and its long shaded portal, the next wave curling smoothly down towards sea and a grassy crown above. Emphasize how the white surfaces change elevation continuously along their length and how sculptural shoulders merge into ground without sharp flat ledges. Show an upper curving road with a tiny camper entering the portal, physically under the raised crest, with a gentle vehicle approach. The camera is on a pedestrian promenade distinct from the road. The foreground path curves gently upward as a flowing ramp; distant central white crescent island may appear through a gap beyond the curves. A turquoise sea on one side, open natural green-gold meadow slopes with small irregular tree clusters on the other. No repeated conventional bridge piers, no horizontal stacked slabs, no flat contour terrace bands, no geometric regular stairs, no dense fins. Three broad coherent gestures, solid landscape interrupted by a selective long opening. The curves themselves RISE, FALL and BANK.
Material must read as artificial warm ivory satin-gloss architectural coating with soft specular highlights, subtle fine grain, not chalk or travertine. Warm gray shaded underside, preserve depth and contact shadows, sparse restrained post-apocalyptic recolonizing plants, not heavy ruined concrete. Sunny pale-blue daylight, coherent with overview. Very wide 16:9 architectural render, eye-level foreground path leading into dramatic curved topography, balanced readable geometry, no lettering, no UI, no watermark.
b_detail:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: near-view architectural concept, design B interwoven rising shells, same Prism Route coastal region.
Input image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE design B overview: preserve its interleaving curved white planted shells, arching openings and crescent coast. Input image 2 is supporting flowing structural-language reference only.
Generate a NEW CAMERA view inside the largest open hollow under the central lifted shell, looking outward diagonally towards turquoise water and the next rising shell. This is the SAME scheme, no unrelated buildings. A narrow pedestrian path in the foreground curves and gently rises beside a single dark-gray road; the road passes through the hollow and joins a short bridge beyond, supported by organically thickening curved shell haunches. Show a tiny camper for scale. Keep road to lower third of frame so most image describes the sculptural architecture and planted layered slopes. The underside of the central shell twists and climbs above us, joining its curved support continuously; through its opening we see another leaflike planted shell rising from the coast, banking and returning to the headland. An asymmetrical gap of sky between two interleaved curved edges reveals significant continuous height variation. Landform crowns are hills with mixed green meadow, gold grasses and wind-shaped trees, not flat green roofs. Make 3 large gestures legible, not ornamental strips. No giant all-enclosing tunnel, no flat slab stack, no regular arch repetition, no straight retaining walls, no conventional column forest.
Warm ivory satin-gloss architectural shell surfaces with refined broad sunlight reflection, extremely subtle engineered microtexture. Warm-gray shadows, plausible real depth, airy daylight openings, pale-blue sky, coastal vegetation lightly reclaiming this infrastructure in a restrained post-apocalyptic landscape. Coherent high-end architectural render matching overview palette. Wide 16:9, low human perspective but enough open sky and curving crowns to show torsion and rise/fall, no text, no watermark, no UI.
